query:
UPDATE draft
               SET value = to_json(
                   CASE WHEN to_jsonb(value) -> 'path' = to_jsonb($2::text)
                        THEN jsonb_set(to_jsonb(value), ARRAY['path'], to_jsonb($1::text), false)
                        ELSE to_jsonb(value)
                   END
               )
               WHERE id = ANY($3)
